title: Fe–N–C catalyst with atomic Fe dispersion and hierarchical porosity via PVP-assisted MOF synthesis for ORR in acidic media
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34524-34536
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05653E, Paper
Open Access

Muhammad Shoaib, Shagufta Ishtiaque, Ahsan Abdul Ghani, Zahoor Awan, Abid Ali, Ayisha Rubab, Maaz Akhtar
A PVP-assisted MOF strategy integrates atomic Fe dispersion, Fe–Nx enrichment, and porosity in one step, yielding a durable Fe–N–C catalyst that surpasses Pt/C in acidic ORR.
